evidence_notes: Nina is 26 and was diagnosed with Crohn's at 19. She also has severe eczema and bipolar II disorder. Her Crohn's started in college and progressed, leading to flares, depression, and dropping out. She tried mesalamine, prednisone (which triggered a hypomanic episode), and methotrexate (causing nausea). Humira was a game-changer initially, controlling Crohn's but causing severe eczema. She is now on Stelara, which helps both conditions somewhat. She was diagnosed with bipolar disorder last year and is on mood stabilizers. She struggles with dating and maintaining a facade at work. Her parents are supportive but burnt out. She finds DBT therapy helpful and is considering ketamine therapy. Her diet is limited due to both Crohn's and eczema triggers. Surgery is a possibility if Stelara fails.
